name: sasya-naturals-ecommerce
description: Sasya Naturals (sasynaturals.com) — Isomorphic Node.js SSR + Rust WASM E-Commerce Platform & 5-Role Admin Portal

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path rust/sasya_commerce_core/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cp rust/sasya_commerce_core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sasya_commerce_core.wasm src/core/checkout/wasm_core.wasm && cp rust/sasya_commerce_core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sasya_commerce_core.wasm public/assets/wasm_core.wasm
